name: dealhub-onboarding
description: Run DealHub customer onboarding: gather context from Gong, Fathom, Google Docs and the CSM into one customer profile, then generate the kickoff deck from the company Google Slides template. Includes a debug mode that uses local mock data.

workspace_dir.title: Onboarding workspace folder
workspace_dir.description: Folder that holds one sub-folder per customer (profile, sources, log). Debug runs go to its _debug sub-folder.

kickoff_template_id.title: Kickoff template (Google Slides ID)
kickoff_template_id.description: ID of the company kickoff template: the part of its URL between /d/ and /edit. Not needed in debug mode.

drive_folder_id.title: Drive folder for generated decks (optional)
drive_folder_id.description: Google Drive folder ID where new decks are saved. Leave blank to save in My Drive.

google_email.title: Your Google Workspace email
google_email.description: The DealHub Google account used to read Drive and build decks. Not needed in debug mode.

google_oauth_client_id.title: Google OAuth client ID
google_oauth_client_id.description: Company Google OAuth client (Desktop app) for the Google Workspace connector. Ask CS Ops / IT. Not needed in debug mode.

google_oauth_client_secret.title: Google OAuth client secret
google_oauth_client_secret.description: Secret for the client ID above. Stored in secure storage, not in settings files. Not needed in debug mode.
